title: Lifted LP-packings outside generalized semifield spreads
summary: Determine whether a source-lifted elementary-abelian LP-packing can have provenance outside every generalized-semifield-spread construction.

formal_statement.body: Let $\mathcal P$ be an LP-packing in an elementary abelian group obtained by the lifting procedure of the source. Does there exist such a $\mathcal P$ that cannot be obtained from any generalized semifield spread? A positive answer requires a constructed lifted packing together with a proof excluding every generalized-semifield-spread origin; a negative answer requires a proof that every source-lifted elementary-abelian LP-packing is obtainable from one.

scope.domain: Bent partitions, LP-packings, and generalized semifield spreads in finite abelian groups
assumptions: The ambient group is elementary abelian
The LP-packing is produced by the lifting procedure fixed in the source
Obtainability from a generalized semifield spread uses the source equivalence and construction conventions
scope.unresolved_remainder: No inspected construction supplies a lifted LP-packing with the required universal non-provenance certificate, and no theorem proves that every source-lifted packing comes from a generalized semifield spread.

progress.summary: The source asks whether some elementary-abelian LP-packings obtained by its lifting procedure lie outside all generalized-semifield-spread constructions.
